Quotation.title: Quotation
Quotation.description: Represents a quotation generated by the Quotation Builder.

quotationId.description: Unique identifier for the Quotation entity.

clientDetails.description: JSON string containing the client's details.

products.description: JSON string representing the products included in the quotation.

pricing.description: JSON string representing the pricing details for the quotation.

totals.description: JSON string representing the total costs for the quotation.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the quotation was created, represented as an ISO 8601 date-time string.

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user who created the quotation.

status.description: The status of the quotation (e.g., ACTIVE, ARCHIVED).

definition.description: Stores quotation data. Includes denormalized 'createdBy' field for authorization independence.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to ensure that the quotation lifecycle supports AI intelligence by persisting quotation data and managing the active/archived status effectively. The structure enforces Authorization Independence by storing all necessary data, including the 'createdBy' field, directly within the quotation document. This eliminates the need for security rules to fetch data from other documents, ensuring atomic operations and easy debugging.

The structure supports the required QAPs (Query, Aggregation, and Pagination) as follows:

*   Secure List Operations (QAP): The structure uses structural segregation by storing quotations in a flat collection (`/quotations`). Access control is managed via the 'createdBy' field combined with the 'status' field, ensuring that only authorized users can list and query quotations based on their 'createdBy' and 'status'.

To enforce the 'ACTIVE DEAL RULE' (only one active quotation per user/session), a transaction or batched write operation will be used to atomically update the status of previously active quotations to 'ARCHIVED' when a new quotation is created with 'ACTIVE' status.

Denormalization Strategy: The 'createdBy' field is included in the quotation document to avoid dependency on the user document for authorization. This allows for secure list operations and avoids complex security rules that require fetching data from other documents.

The AI Intelligence page queries the `quotations` collection where `status == 'ACTIVE'` and orders by `createdAt DESC` with a `LIMIT 1`, which is directly supported by this structure. This setup supports easy querying and filtering based on the status of the quotation.
